test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Sporadic
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4' **i.e.** 'Systematic'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym for the word** "Sporadic"** is: **Systematic.**
 
• **"Sporadic"** means occurring at irregular intervals or only in a few places; scattered or isolated.(छितपुट, यदा कदा)
 
• **"Systematic"** means done or acting according to a fixed plan or system; methodical.(व्यवस्थित)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: '**Systematic'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here's the explanation for the other options:
 
 
• **Scattered -** It refers to things that are spread over an area in an irregular way.(छितरा)
 
• **Random -** It refers to something made, done, or happening without method or conscious decision, which can be irregular and infrequent.(यादृच्छिक )
 
• **Rare -** It signifies something not occurring or found very often.(दुर्लभ)
 
 

44:Ta91,

The correct answer is "Option 4'
